en.headline: Transport Department says Huanggang signs are ready
en.dek: The department said display screens, large stickers and queue rails are in place at the new port interchange, with ambassadors on the second-floor lobby at opening.
body: The Transport Department said on Monday that passenger information at the public transport interchange of the rebuilt Huanggang port is ready, as the crossing's opening draws near.

On its social media page, the department said extra display screens have been added at main points and near boarding areas, showing bus and minibus destinations, stops and boarding positions. Large stickers and directional signs, including vehicle icons, route numbers and directions, are also in place, and operators have set up stop plates and queue rails so passengers can board in order.

In the early days of service, ambassadors will be on the second-floor lobby to help people choose a route into the urban area, the department said. It said it will review common passenger questions and adjust the information as needed. The department did not give an opening date in the statement.

zh.headline: 運輸署：皇崗口岸交匯處資訊已準備就緒
zh.dek: 署方表示交匯處已加設顯示屏、大型標貼及排隊欄杆，口岸初期會有服務大使在二樓大堂協助乘客揀選出市區路線。
body: 運輸署星期一表示，重建後的皇崗口岸即將開通，口岸公共運輸交匯處的各項乘客資訊已經準備就緒。
署方在社交專頁說，已在交匯處主要位置和上客區附近加設多個顯示屏，顯示巴士及小巴的目的地、途經站點和登車位置。各主要位置亦備有大型標貼和導向指示，包括不同交通工具圖案、路線號碼和方向；各營辦商已安排站牌和排隊欄杆，方便乘客有序登車。
運輸署又說，口岸投入服務初期，服務大使會在二樓大堂協助市民選擇合適路線出市區。署方會總結乘客常見問題，按需要優化資訊配套。聲明沒有公布具體開通日期。
